notes.title: Game Update 1.0.5.4
notes.content: This update addresses an issue where some Samurai Shodown III levels were not correctly loading when selected in the collection's offline versus mode. An issue involving Steam achievements potentially not properly unlocking if players had a connected account has also been resolved.

notes.title: Game Update 1.0.5.3
notes.content:
This update addresses an issue that caused some players to be removed from the leaderboards after they had achieved a certain, high score. After installing the new update, all leaderboards will be wiped for each player. However, once you play a single, online match in each game, your correct score and win/game count will be restored to the leaderboards for that particular game. No data should be lost.

We have also resolved a minor crash issue that could occur in Samurai Shodown and Samurai Showdown III under specific situations.

notes.title: Game Update 1.0.5.1
notes.content: Due to some recent changes to the Epic backend, we have had to make some adjustments for the game's matchmaking system. These changes should address the disconnection issues that players have been experiencing over the last day or so.
